page.layout: One printed page with two columns of Greek word index, each line a word followed by its page and line references. Column 1 (left) runs from the top to the foot, with alphabetical letter headings X., Ψ., Ω. set inside it. Column 2 (right) runs parallel to the first. Below both columns is the closing word ΤΕΛΟΣ. A strip of the neighbouring page's edge appears at the far left and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The first line of the right column is read as ὠμίλει with a probable accent difference. Greek words marked [?] are doubtful readings of the printed Greek. The strip of the neighbouring page at the far left (small English-looking index lines) is not part of this page and is not transcribed. No page number is printed.
